description: This Java class 'ContactPhotoBinder' is a custom cursor binder used in an Android application to bind contact photos to list items by querying contact images based on contact IDs and setting them as compound drawables on TextViews.

classes.name: ContactPhotoBinder
classes.description: A custom cursor binder for binding contact photos to list items in an Android app.

methods.name: ContactPhotoBinder
methods.description: Constructor initializing resources, default drawable, cache, and photo size based on display density.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a contact photo to a TextView by querying contact data and caching the drawable.
